test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per provisions given in Article 76 of the Indian Constitution, the President shall appoint a person as Attorney-General for India who is qualified to be ____________.

options.text: appointed as Judge of any High Court
appointed as Minister in any State Cabinet
appointed as Minister in the Union Cabinet
appointed as Judge of the Supreme Court

solution:
The correct answer is __**appointed as Judge of the Supreme Court**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Attorney General of India is part of the Union Executive of India. AG is the highest law officer of India.
 
• Article 76 talks about the office of the Attorney General of India.
 
• AG is the chief legal advisor to the government of India.
 
• AG is not considered a government servant. 
 
• The remuneration of the Attorney General is determined by the President.

*Hence, Article 76 of the Indian Constitution deals with the provision of the Attorney-General of India.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__***

Eligibility: 

 
• She/ He must be qualified to be appointed as Supreme Court judge.
 
• Must be a citizen of India.
 
• Served as a Judge of the High Court for 5 years as an advocate.
 
• Should be an eminent jurist in the President's opinion.
 
• Appointment: Appointed by the President on the advice of the government. 
 
• The tenure of AG is not fixed by the Constitution.
 
• AG holds office during the pleasure of the government. She/He can be removed by the President any time. 

 

 
• **Functions of Attorney General:**
 
• Performs legal duties on behalf of the Government of India.
 
• Right to participate in the proceedings of the Parliament and though he/she does not have the right to vote.
 
• Appears on behalf of the Government of India in all cases in the apex court.
 
• AG is assisted by two Solicitor Generals and four Additional Solicitor Generals.
